yaml:
name: Check Release
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install just
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y just
      - name: Check release
        run: |
          just check-release
